description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Changes where an existing ad set runs. `excludeAudienceNetwork: true` keeps Facebook, Instagram and Messenger and drops Audience Network; or pass an explicit publisherPlatforms list. `id` is the ad set id from ads_campaign_get. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity. It cannot be undone from there: to change it back, call this tool again with the earlier settings.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/ad-sets/{id}/placements.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_ad_set_placements
title: Edit ad set placements
